globalaccountclosure-desc: Provides global account closure and restoration tools.
closeaccount-intro: Close a global account without locking it. Closed accounts cannot log in or edit.
closeaccount-legend: Close or restore a global account
closeaccount-success: The global account for "<nowiki>$1</nowiki>" has been closed globally.
closeaccount-restored: The global account for "<nowiki>$1</nowiki>" has been restored.
closeaccount-already-closed: The global account for "<nowiki>$1</nowiki>" is already closed.
closemyaccount-intro: Close your global account. You will no longer be able to log in or edit on any wiki. You can restore the account later with your global password.
closemyaccount-invalid: Your account could not be closed. Check your global password and make sure the account is not already closed or globally locked.
closemyaccount-already-closed: Your global account is already closed. [[Special:RestoreClosedAccount|Restore your account]] with your global password.
closemyaccount-success: Your global account has been closed. [[Special:RestoreClosedAccount|Restore it]] with your global password if you change your mind.
restoreaccount-intro: Your global account is closed. Enter your global password to restore access.
restoreaccount-invalid: The account could not be restored. Check the username and password, and make sure the account is closed and not globally locked.
restoreaccount-success: Your global account for "<nowiki>$1</nowiki>" has been restored. You can now log in.
centralauth-contribs-closed:
This account is closed.
See [[Special:CentralAuth/$1|global account details]] for more information.
centralauth-contribs-closed-log:
